scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:api
scripts.quality:gate: npm run check:routes && npm run check:settlement && npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w packages/contracts && npm run evidence -w packages/contracts && npm run test -w apps/api && npm run eval:policy -w apps/api && npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.redeploy:sepolia: npm run deploy:sepolia:full -w packages/contracts && npm run verify -w packages/contracts -- --network arbitrumSepolia
scripts.redeploy:robinhood: npm run deploy:robinhood:full -w packages/contracts && npm run verify -w packages/contracts -- --network robinhoodTestnet
scripts.preflight: npm run quality:gate && npm run check:deployed && npm run check:settlement && npm run submission:check && npm run push:audit
